meta.name: thermodrift-instrument
sources: Website Lab restyle: Art Deco / Parisian editorial layer and validated dark-mode data pair (2026-10-29)
rules: Brand red is a fill behind white text or the logo itself; it never signals an error, clipping or recording.
Data colours identify series; status colours identify states. Neither is ever used alone: pair with text, icon or shape.
Square geometry by default; rounded corners only for editorial CTAs.
Brass and ivory are editorial: frames, kickers, numerals and photo mats. They never encode data or status.

red.use: logo red; title labels, primary action fill (white text)

brass.use: editorial accent: hairlines, frames, kickers, numerals; never data or status

ivory.use: mat behind photographs and screenshots (inverse text)

rose.use: eyes closed; primary series; key numbers

periwinkle.use: eyes open; secondary series; raw trace; links

neutral.use: excluded, unknown, reference electrode in diagrams

simulated.use: synthetic or replayed data, never live hardware

editorial.use: brand voice: headings, titles, editorial prose (brand guide)

ui.value: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
ui.use: instrument controls and dense labels (decision: legibility at 12–14 px; no font files shipped)

numeric.value: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
numeric.use: live numbers, axes, tables (Georgia's old-style figures shift when values update)

motion.reduced: Under prefers-reduced-motion: no pulses, no slides, no animated charts; state changes are instant.
